sentences: For `v_cvt_f32_f64` and either source of `v_add_f64`, a literal dword supplies bits 63:32 and bits 31:0 are zero.
Inline integers are sign-extended and inline floats use their binary64 value.
For example, gfx1030 `llvm-mc` encodes 1.5 as the literal word `0x3ff80000`.

The synthetic `tests/semantic/fixtures/f64_literals.asm` checks both source words in the translated SPIR-V, including the distinction between the printed literal `0x1` and inline `1`. [LLVM AMDGPU operand conversions](https://releases.llvm.org/15.0.0/docs/AMDGPUOperandSyntax.html#integer-literals)
